newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yamaichi shares ease on newspaper report. [CORRECTED 02:26 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Yamaichi shares ease on newspaper report. [CORRECTED 02:26 GMT]

text.p: Shares in Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd dipped on Monday morning on a newspaper report that Yamaichi, one of Japan's "Big Four" brokerages (corrects to make clear that only Yamaichi was mentioned in the report), reimbursed Hanwa Co Ltd for investment losses in 1992, brokers said.
Yamaichi's shares fell eight yen to 346 at 0053 GMT. Volume was 1.279 million shares.
The Sankei Shimbun said Yamaichi transferred about 18.9 billion yen to Hanwa between April and September 1992 through transactions involving bonds with equity-purchase warrants.
A Yamaichi spokesman said the company could not immediately comment on the report, but would try to make checks. Hanwa officials were not immediately available for comment.
